rows.en: (Oh, it's Ranka's song...)

(Ever since she played Mao Nome in the movie
"BIRD HUMAN," she's gotten really famous.)
rows.notes: Film title 'BIRD HUMAN -Tori no Hito-': the Japanese subtitle just repeats the title, so only 'BIRD HUMAN' is kept.

rows.en:
(I'm going to Ranka's concert tomorrow too,
so I'd better enjoy it to the fullest.)

(Now then, maybe I'll pick up a little gift
to congratulate Ranka on the w......)
rows.notes: Cut off by the broadcast, as in the Japanese ('...kaitte iko').

rows.en: (An evacuation alert...! The Vajra again!?)

(I somehow made it to the shelter...
When are these Vajra attacks ever going to stop?)
Oh, Nanase.

I felt so uneasy all alone,
so I'm glad I ran into you...
Yeah, me too......

(That impact was way bigger than usual...
Was that a direct hit...?)

Saotome-kun and the others aren't here...
Will Luca-kun be all right...?

Luca will pull it off, I'm sure.
Let's believe in him and wait.

(All I can do is believe in everyone
and wait...)

This is the Macross Frontier Administrative Bureau.
The evacuation alert issued to all ships
has been lifted. Repeat...
(Looks like the battle's over...)

(Still, today's battle went on longer than usual...
I guess that means the Vajra attacks are getting
that much fiercer...)

(Alto and the others are giving it their all.
We're bound to be fine from here on, too...)
(Oh, it's Ranka-chan's song...)

(Ever since she played Mao Nome in the movie
"BIRD HUMAN," she's gotten really famous.)
rows.notes: Film title 'BIRD HUMAN -Tori no Hito-': the Japanese subtitle just repeats the title, so only 'BIRD HUMAN' is kept.

rows.en:
(I'm going to Ranka-chan's concert tomorrow too,
so I'd better enjoy it to the fullest.)

(Now then, maybe I'll pick up a little gift
to congratulate Ranka-chan on the w......)

(I somehow made it to the shelter...
When are these Vajra attacks ever going to stop?)
Yeah, me too......
Wah!
rows.notes: Female twin of c17760 'uwa' (Whoa!); this is the shorter 'wa'.

rows.en:
(That impact was way bigger than usual...
Was that a direct hit...?)

Luca-kun will pull it off, I'm sure.
Let's believe in him and wait.

(All I can do is believe in everyone
and wait...)
(Looks like the battle's over...)

(Still, today's battle went on longer than usual...
I guess that means the Vajra attacks are getting
that much fiercer...)

(Saotome-kun and the others are giving it their
all. We're bound to be fine from here on, too...)

(But will this super-long-distance fold
really let Frontier escape the Vajra?)

(There's no point in me worrying about it.
For now, I'll just enjoy the Everything-Must-Go
Fold Clearance Sale......)
rows.notes: Shop sale name (zaiko issou nageuri fold sale) translated as a title; not in the glossary.

rows.en: (An evacuation alert!? Could it be...!)

(No way... The Vajra showing up right before
the super-long-distance fold...)

(Ranka's song is supposed to work on the Vajra,
but who knows how long that'll last...)

(Sooner or later, the Vajra are going to get us
and......)
rows.notes: Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
We will now perform an emergency
super-long-distance fold.

All citizens, please take cover at home or in
the nearest shelter and prepare for the fold.

(A fold, in this situation!?
Is it really going to be okay?)

(...No, it'll be fine.
Ranka, the Super Dimension Cinderella, is singing.
It's bound to succeed!)

(Not just Ranka...
Alto, everyone, you hang in there too...)
This is the Macross Frontier Administrative Bureau.

The Frontier fleet has successfully completed
the super-long-distance fold. Repeat...

(We did it... We did it!
Now the fight with the Vajra is over!)

(Thanks for protecting us, Ranka,
and Alto and the others too...)

(But will this super-long-distance fold
really let Frontier escape the Vajra?)

(There's no point in me worrying about it.
For now, I'll just enjoy the Everything-Must-Go
Fold Clearance Sale......)

(Ranka-chan's song is supposed to work on the
Vajra, but who knows how long that'll last...)

(Sooner or later, the Vajra are going to get us
and......)

(A fold, in this situation!?
Is it really going to be okay?)

(...No, it'll be fine.
Ranka-chan, the Super Dimension Cinderella,
is singing. It's bound to succeed!)

(Not just Ranka-chan...
Saotome-kun, everyone, you hang in there too...)

(We did it... We did it!
Now the fight with the Vajra is over!)

(Thanks for protecting us, Ranka-chan,
and Saotome-kun and the others too...)

(Damn it! It's dangerous here!
I need to get to a shelter right away!)

(I somehow made it to the shelter... but it's
full of injured people. It's horrible.)

What happened to Ranka Lee!?
I thought the Vajra would stop if that girl sang...
They said we'd get away!
It's hopeless... We're all gonna die......

(Everyone's reached their mental limit...
At this rate......)
Yeah, it's Sheryl...
Sheryl......

(Even on the brink of despair like this,
Sheryl hasn't given up...)
(It'll be okay... It's bound to be okay......!)

(Looks like the Vajra were somehow
wiped out...)
rows.notes: Civilian branch: the player did not fight, so the line says the Vajra were wiped out rather than 'we wiped them out'.

rows.en:
(It's all thanks to Alto and the others,
Ranka... and Sheryl too.)
rows.notes: Phrased like the finished female twin c21105.
Shared male/female; the finished female next row c21106 also opens with 'But', so the thought restarts.

rows.en:
(But no matter how you look at it, Frontier
took way too much damage this time...!)
rows.notes: Matches the finished female twin c21106.

rows.en:
(The ship's in tatters, and the ecosystem can't
be sustained anymore... What are we supposed
to do in a situation like this......?)
rows.notes: Matches the finished female twin c21107; also used in scd_sms_809 (male).

rows.en:
(Ugh! It's dangerous here!
I need to get to a shelter right away!)

(I somehow made it to the shelter... but it's
full of injured people. It's horrible.)
Sheryl-san......

(Even on the brink of despair like this,
Sheryl-san hasn't given up...)
(It'll be okay... It's bound to be okay......!)

(Looks like the Vajra were somehow
wiped out...)

uncertain: c21026/c21043: film title given as 'BIRD HUMAN' only (Japanese subtitle repeats it).
c21056/c21071: in-universe sale name rendered 'Everything-Must-Go Fold Clearance Sale'.
c21094/c21095: male '(But......)' followed by '(But no matter how...)' to match the finished female twin c21106; the double 'But' reads as a restart.
